summary: Central Plains Bancshares, Inc. filed an 8-K on September 10, 2026 disclosing that its board approved a new stock repurchase program on September 9, 2026, authorizing up to 417,481 shares, roughly 10% of current outstanding common stock, replacing the existing program. No price per share, premium, or expiration date was stated. The program is a capital-return mechanism for the Nasdaq-listed thrift holding company, funded from available resources. No advisor or regulatory clock was named. Watch repurchase pace, capital levels, and whether buybacks support book value per share versus any eventual whole-bank sale.
